title: Playwright run report — intermediate format
description: Format produced by extract.mjs from Playwright's JSON reporter, and consumed by render.mjs (HTML), the job summary, and the automated issue. Three rules: the consumer computes nothing, interprets nothing, and never finds binary bytes in here (paths only).

schemaVersion.description: The consumer checks this value and stops with an explicit message if it doesn't recognize it.

areas.description: Already sorted by the extractor: broken, then degraded, then ok; ties broken alphabetically by label.

tests.description: Already sorted by the extractor: failed, flaky, skipped, passed; ties broken by area then by title.

attempt.description: GitHub re-runs increment this, not the id.

status.description: When not completed, stats are partial and the page must say so at the top.

isProduction.description: Dedicated boolean, never a string comparison against 'prod' done by the renderer. This is the safeguard against reporting a staging bug as if it were production.

suiteLabel.description: What was chosen in the workflow's dropdown. Without this the reader assumes the run covers the whole system.

timezone.description: IANA, e.g. Europe/Rome. The file is opened offline: the timezone must not depend on the reader's browser.

stats.description: Invariant: total = passed + failed + flaky + skipped. Flaky tests are NOT counted among passed. Verified by validate.mjs, not expressible in JSON Schema.

passRate.description: passed / (total - skipped) * 100, already rounded to one decimal. Skipped tests are excluded from the denominator, otherwise skipping tests would artificially raise the percentage. Equals 100 when total - skipped is zero.

id.description: Matches the Playwright tag without the leading @. Untagged tests end up in 'other', normalized by the extractor.

label.description: Display label, taken from areas.json. Renamable without touching test code.

status.description: Precomputed: broken with at least one failed, degraded with only flaky, otherwise ok.

id.description: Stable hash of file + titlePath, truncated to 8 characters. Never Playwright's internal id, which isn't stable across runs. Used to correlate the same test across different runs once history is reintroduced.

title.description: The title exactly as written in the test. The script may polish the structure, not invent the wording.

area.description: Never null: the extractor normalizes untagged tests to 'other'.

status.description: Playwright's timedOut is normalized to failed with error.category = timeout: the distinction matters to whoever writes the tests, not to whoever reads the report.

steps.description: Populated only for failed and flaky, to keep the file's weight down. Also null when the error happened outside any step (failed import, file that doesn't compile).

failedStepIndex.description: Index into steps. Null when steps is null.

error.description: For flaky tests, contains the error from the failed attempt, not the last one.

title.description: Playwright hooks are relabeled by the extractor: 'beforeEach hook' becomes 'Test setup'.

category.description: Closed enum. With unknown, the renderer shows raw directly, with no accompanying sentence.

human.description: Plain-language sentence generated by the extractor. Null when the category is unknown or when there's nothing useful to say: a generic 'something went wrong' is worse than the raw message, because it doesn't inform and it erodes trust.

raw.description: Playwright's message with ANSI escape codes already stripped. Playwright's JSON contains the sequences used for terminal colors; passed through as-is into HTML they turn into stray escape codes scattered across the text.

attachments.description: Paths relative to the repo root, never base64: inlining is done by render.mjs at the last moment, so run.json stays lightweight, readable, and diffable. For flaky tests these are the failed attempt's attachments, not the last one's: a screenshot of a working screen explains nothing.
